description.value: Church's Chicken is a fast-food chain location on Kingsway in Vancouver serving fried chicken meals, sandwiches, and sides. The local franchise operates under the brand 'Church's Texas Chicken™' and emphasizes hand-crafted, Texas-style fried chicken for the Lower Mainland market. It offers drive-through and indoor seating in a single-storey retail building.
